title: Added sugar recommendations in the Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2025-2030
html: The Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2025-2030 (DGA) introduce a substantive revision to added sugar guidance, shifting from a daily percentage-based limit to a per-meal quantitative limit.1 The 2020-2025 DGA advised limiting added sugars to less than 10% of total daily caloric intake for people 2 years and older and avoiding added sugars for children younger than 2 years.2 The 2025-2030 DGA recommend avoiding added sugars during infancy and early childhood and limiting intake to no more than 10 g per meal thereafter.
